program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((col-modes (for/list ((c (range 0 w)))
                               (mode-list (for/list ((r (range 0 h))) (at g r c)))))
                  (row-modes (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                               (mode-list (for/list ((c (range 0 w))) (at g r c)))))
                  (col-coherence (for/sum ((c (range 0 w)))
                                   (let ((m (list-ref col-modes c)))
                                     (for/sum ((r (range 0 h)))
                                       (if (= (at g r c) m) 1 0)))))
                  (row-coherence (for/sum ((r (range 0 h)))
                                   (let ((m (list-ref row-modes r)))
                                     (for/sum ((c (range 0 w)))
                                       (if (= (at g r c) m) 1 0))))))
             (if (> col-coherence row-coherence)
                 (cellmap g (r c v) (list-ref col-modes c))
                 (cellmap g (r c v) (list-ref row-modes r)))))))
